name: How long does a rental property remodel take between tenants?

mainEntity.name: How long does a rental property remodel take between tenants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most rental property renovations take between two and six weeks, depending on the scope of the project. A standard turnover involving drywall repairs, interior paint, trim installation, and minor bathroom updates usually takes one to two weeks. Full kitchen renovations, layout adjustments, or multi-room rehabs require three to six weeks due to trade scheduling and material lead times. Owner Abraham Becerra stays on-site to lead carpentry, tile, and drywall work directly, which helps streamline trade handoffs for plumbing and electrical and minimizes rental vacancy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic rental updates typically take one to two weeks, while full kitchen and bathroom renovations generally take three to six weeks.
